description: Fetches news articles and bilateral relations information from the Azerbaijan Ministry of Foreign Affairs website (www.mfa.gov.az).

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_news_article: Extract a specific news article by URL; requires url parameter; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - list_news: List news articles with pagination; optional page and lang parameters; 参数: page, lang; 必填: 无
  - get_bilateral_relations: Extract bilateral relations info for a country; requires url or region+country; 参数: url, region, country, lang; 必填: 无

url.description: Full URL to the page (news article or bilateral relations page)

page.description: Page number for news listing (default 1, used by list_news)

lang.description: Language code - 'en' for English, 'az' for Azerbaijani (default 'en')
